preprocessing: Exclude Fit <= 0.5 (nonfunctional floor); source has no values below 0.5.
Use f = natural logarithm of (Fit / 0.5), equivalent in differences to authors log fitness ratios.
Keep isolated viable genotypes in the control population.
Serialize float64 values with 17 significant digits; read float_precision=round_trip.

author_rng.global: For each directed mutation with n backgrounds, a fresh numpy.random.RandomState(n**2 + 3).

note: Numerical genotype/fitness facts extracted from the author data; not GraphFLA-generated targets. No repository-wide license is asserted for the source.
